meta.conceptLabel: 春の食卓をめぐる静かな詩的ヒーリング
meta.tempoPolicy: 62-68 BPM center. Never increase BPM to shorten duration.
meta.energyPolicy: Playlist-wide energy ceiling 2.2/5. No sudden energy spike, bright novelty track, full-band chorus blast or abrupt density jump.
meta.genrePolicy: Quiet 1970s Japanese New Music, soft Kayokyoku and acoustic Folk only. No Showa Groove, funk, Motown pulse, wah guitar, clavinet, brass stabs or upbeat family-pop treatment.
meta.lyricPolicy: Metaphor-led poetic Japanese. Do not explain family relationships, emotions or lessons. Avoid direct kinship labels in lyrics. One central concrete metaphor per track.
meta.vocalPolicy: Mature low-mid chest voices, calm neutral expression, narrow melodic range, almost straight tone, tiny delayed vibrato, no falsetto climax, belt, octave lift or bright youthful tone.
meta.arrangementPolicy: Core palette: upright/electric piano, nylon/fingerpicked acoustic guitar, cello, viola, clarinet/bass clarinet and soft bass. Drums absent on most tracks; when used, feather-light brushes only. Maximum four clearly audible instruments at once.
meta.durationPolicy: 44-48 effective bars, compact three-scene lyric form, one 4-bar instrumental break, no long coda, no repeated outro and no extra final refrain.
meta.revisionNoteKo: 001 전체를 일본 시니어 채널용 저에너지 일관성 기준으로 전면 재작성했다. 갑자기 밝아지거나 리듬이 튀는 트랙을 없애고, 가족설명형 가사를 사물 중심 은유형 가사로 바꿨으며, 곡 길이는 2분 42초~2분 55초 중심으로 압축했다.
